title: MWS 8-year resurvey — Demographics
description: Questionnaire version and submission year for the 8-year ('lilac') resurvey.

F2QTYPE.title: Questionnaire version
F2QTYPE.$comment: Third distinct questionnaire-version scheme in this package: the code value is the version tag itself (512, 605), not a small ordinal like recruitment's RQTYPE (1-3) or resurvey_3yr's F1QTYPE (1-4). Available on every version, as expected for a field whose own job is identifying the version.

F2YSUBMT.title: Year questionnaire completed
F2YSUBMT.$comment: Bound removed entirely -- the earlier agent-decided/derived plausibility bound was retired per Montse's dictionary-fidelity requirement (D101-D104) (the old bound was derived from F2QTYPE's own fielding-year metadata, not a number the dictionary itself states for this field -- D084 is superseded).
